description: Example 01 with PC_ISOLATION PROCESS and PC_WORKER_TIMEOUT: 01's results in either isolation mode.

evaluations.note: As example 01 (the same search in worker processes): 30 on the reference machine since the neighbour lists are exact (2026-09-30; 16 before). BFGS reaches the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 at eval 9 (the best, 1.031156e-01), and from eval 13 on its line search re-evaluates the clamped bound; its sufficient-decrease test there depends on the sign of the ~1e-13 relative re-evaluation noise of the warm-started lattice relaxation. On the reference machine it never passes and the run continues to MAXEVAL (30, status COMPLETED); with the hot_a0 start 1 ulp lower it passes and BFGS ends after 17 evaluations (as example 05's run with the same search does after 16). So the count is not pinned (evals_tol 14: 16..30, see tolerance_rationale); best loss, components and RCUT2B do not depend on it.

tolerance_rationale: Example 01's search in worker processes, with 01's tolerances: best loss, components and RCUT2B at the defaults, and the evaluation count within evals_tol 14 (16..30), for the reason given in 01's tolerance_rationale (the count at the clamped bound RCUT2B = 6.0 depends on rounding-level noise).
